text:
elena: Heads-up — enterprise pilot asked to expand Dedicated burst credits and add a mid-tier capacity slab. Need quick tradeoff call.

sam: Customer (FinTech) wants predictable monthly spend + headroom for peak trading days. They're pushing for a 4x burst multiplier on Dedicated.

jia: 4x burst is doable technically but will require a soft cap + autoscale cooldowns. Also impacts queueing for other reserved pools.

marco: Commercially, 4x with no overage guard is risky. Suggest: 2x guaranteed, optional 2x burst at higher add-on rate. That keeps commit size lower.

andy: Legal flag — if we sell burst as billed overage, contract needs explicit burst SLA and max exposure clause. I'll draft language if we decide shape.

elena: Launch criteria proposal: (1) define slab sizes (S/M/L), (2) burst addon opt-in with billing cap, (3) autoscale cooldown and quota notice, (4) docs & console UX for opt-in. Thoughts?

sam: +1. Pricing idea: standard tiers include 2x baseline burst. Add-on 'burst-pack' unlocks extra 2x at 3x per-unit price. Simpler for renewals.

jia: For runtime, we need KV-cache reservation signals and a soft preemption policy. I'll prototype a 'burst token' header to mark burst requests.

marco: Important: expose estimated cost of burst usage in Console before commit. Customers won't buy blind. Also telemetry to show burst consumption by route.

elena: Can we ship a beta with docs + flag to 5 pilot customers in 6 weeks? Will we need product analytics events defined now?

jia: 6 weeks is tight but feasible for a limited roll — will scope down: slab plumbing + header + telemetry. No UI polishing first pass.

andy: I'll prepare contract wording and a one-paragraph explainer for CSMs. ETA 2 weeks.

ops-bot: Reminder: create a rollout ticket in https://phabricator/redwood/ with label `pricing-burst-beta` — scheduled for 6/10.

elena: Action items: jia - proto + telemetry; marco - console cost mock; sam - pilot list & pricing feedback; andy - contract language. I'll sync with PM on Friday.

sam: I'll ping the top 3 pilot prospects after pricing mock. :thumbsup:

jia: Noted. I'll open the phab and link PRs to the ticket.

elena: Thanks — keeping this thread as the decision log. If anyone wants to object to the 2x baseline + 2x paid addon shape speak up by EOD tomorrow.
